page.layout: One page of text in one column; in the right margin, level with the last line, one marginal note ("Situs"). Running head at the top; page number at the top left. The left edge shows a fragment of the neighbouring page and the red fore-edge, which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: est in latere Epiri, quâ Thesprotii colunt, extra sinum Adriaticum, non procul distans à continente, xcvii pass. millibus, ut scribit idem Plinius, in longum patens. In hanc igitur insulam affirmat Strabo Corinthiorum coloniam esse deductam, principe Cherficrate Heraclidâ, eadem ætate, qua Syracusæ ab Archiâ fuêre conditæ, & dicit, in solo vetustæ urbis Scheriæ, ejectis inde prioribus habitatoribus Liburnis, colonos hos novos fuisse collocatos. Liburni verò an ex posteris Phæacum fuerint, an pulsis Phæacibus locum occupatum ad id usque tempus tenuerint, incertum. Colonia nova, ut dixi, Corcyræ nomen accepit, idque ei cum totâ insulâ factum commune, veteri nomine obliterato. Hæc etiam ita opibus & populi frequentiâ celeriter crevit ob situs commoditatem, & oportunos portus, recipiendis & emittendis navibus multis maximè idoneos, ut in alia loca colonos ipsa emiserit, novasque civitates quoque genuerit: quod de Epidamno, quæ Latinis est Dyrrachium, ex Thucydide, de Apollonia ex Strabone constat, utraque in Taulantiis, qui Illyriorum pars sunt.Situs

page.notes: The marginal note "Situs" is in italic type, set at the foot of the right margin. The left edge fragments ("nt.") belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Page number 148 and running head DESCRIPTIO are in the printed head. The printed "xcvıı" is copied as "xcvii". Long s is given as plain s throughout.
